page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the line "ribus; non ex operibus". The catchword sits at the lower right. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page (show-through and edge fragments), which is not transcribed.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "sacrificiorum" (the first letter looks like l, marked [?]); "Ipso facto" at the start of the line where the scan is clipped (the initial letter and the word "facto" are unclear, marked [?]); "Respondet" is read from a slightly broken word. The margin note "Ephes. 2. 9." is placed beside the line "ribus; non ex operibus". Edge fragments on the right belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The catchword "ra à" is the start of the next page and is not repeated in the text.
